title: admin.server_suspended
description: ServerSuspended is published by admin when staff suspends a server. The server keeps its content, but nobody can use it until it is reactivated: servers rejects every action on it except leaving, messaging rejects reads and writes in its channels and closes their open sockets, and voice takes whoever is connected out of the room. Version is admin's moderation_version for that server: it grows with every suspension, reactivation or deletion request, and a consumer applies an event only if its version is higher than the one it already has. The reason never travels (data minimisation).

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

server_id.description: Servidor suspendido, reactivado o a eliminar (ID de discordia-servers).

version.description: moderation_version del servidor en admin. Crece con cada suspensión, reactivación o eliminación; ordena los eventos del mismo servidor.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 en hexadecimal. Ver la sección "Firma" de la descripción del documento.
